avis.texte: Love it's all natural ingredients. Great coverage. Would definitely buy this again

While this works for me and I'll use it up since I own it, this says you need to use 1g of product to get the labeled SPF 50. Theres only 10 grams of product in the compact. That means to get SPF 50 you would only get ten uses out of the compact. That said if you are using your typical spf under it this is a decent product. It's a surprisingly good color for me (beige) and the creme to powder formula worked well for my oily skin. I will probably not repurchase because of the somewhat misleading spf claim.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I have oily skin, the product spread easily with the sponge provided but it left me with a dewy finish so i had to put a matte setting powder so i wouldn't have a super shiny face. The result was fantastic. My skin tone is light/medium so the Sable- Beige was a good match. The color looks darker in the compact but goes on lighter once on the skin.

Was pleasantly surprised that this product was not too dark or "orangy" on my fair skin that does not tan. Its great for sun protection when I'm just running errands or out walking the dog and I don't want to take the time for full make up. It is thick and takes awhile to blend , hence 4 stars instead of 5. But I think will improve when I purchase a new brush for application. If you're on the fence definitely give this a try. Also, its so compact, great for travel ! For reference I use the Sable-beige .

So glad I picked this up at NOLA Ulta. I neglected to pack any makeup for my weekend trip, so I went in to Ulta hoping for a powder, but stopped in my tracks when I saw this Avène compact. The foundation requires a little blending, but the compact comes with the perfect applicator. I've been using nearly every day, bypassing my liquid foundation because it's so quick and easy to use. Got it in beige, because that was what was available, but the color blends perfectly with my Medium skin.

I am light to medium skin tone and bought the "beige". This lighter tone option, looks dark in the compact, but lightens with coverage. I wear tinted sunscreen 365 and have tried everything. This stands out as one of the best tinted sunscreens that can double as light to medium coverage skin tint or foundation. It is creamy when you apply with the sponge, but dries down nicely to a natural finish, and you don't even need to set with powder. It evens and smooths your skin and doesn't settle into fine lines. I would have given 5 stars, but it is very little product for the price.
I have combination. Skin and lately I been struggling with breakups this thing does not dry on my skin.

The colors are limited, but the color beige just happens to be my EXACT skin tone. I've literally never had a foundation match me as well as this sunscreen does. I wasn't expecting for this product to be medium-high coverage, because it's a sunscreen but honestly it just works so well I am not mad about it at all. I use this as foundation, so if ur looking for something that's thinner and more like your typical sunscreen product I would not recommend. Also if ur worried about a color match for reference I am half white and half Latino so I'm slightly tan. If u wouldn't describe ur self as pale and wouldn't describe yourself as completely tan, then Beige might just work for u.
I would love this product if there were ligher shades available. The shades they currently have make me look like an oompa loompa.
This product exceeded my expectation. It makes my morning super easy with a two in one with SPF and foundation in one. Gorgeous tone and full coverage! Huge plus thag it doesnt clog pores.
I love this compact powder for its sun protection factor, it has very good coverage, it is creamy, for my complexion it is perfect

avis.titre: Oily Skin? Uneven skin? This is for you
avis.texte: If your skin is oily, and you love having a base every day, this is for YOU! Love the shade (I am a light tone in foundation) and this fits perfect. For both seasons.. Easy to retouch, with a mirror to carry wherever.

If you're not wearing a full face of makeup, this is a great way to reapply SPF during the day on the go without having to get product all over your hands or needing to touch your face. Initially I thought the beige looked way too dark (I'm a light warm-neutral) but once you spread it on your skin it lightens up considerably and looks like a tinted moisturizer with light coverage. If I squint hard enough there is a very faint white cast, but it's barely noticeable. All in all if either shade works for you it's a great hands-free light coverage daytime SPF reapplication tool that will stay in my purse!

avis.titre: A bit darker than I thought it would be
avis.texte: I do like the quality of the compact and the creamy texture made it easy apply. I also was very pleased that it has SPF. However, the color is a bit darker than I thought it would be. I would only purchase again if it was available in a lighter color.

This is thick and immediately settles into any lines and wrinkles you might have. The lighter shade has a bit of an orange hue on my fair/light skin. It looks just awful. It might have good sun protection, but I wouldn't want to wear this around other humans who can see my face.

i love avene and have gotten their liquid tinted moisturizer in europe which i love but this is a miss for me. it highlights every bit of texture and dry skin i have. there are way better powder foundations with spf. i wosh this was just liquid

avis.titre: I would buy it again but only when I'm back home
avis.texte: The US packaging does not include the expiration date, unlike the packaging back in Europe. I'm unsure why. The product is thick. I don't use it as a standalone sunscreen. I use it as a touch-up throughout the day.

avis.titre: Best tinted sunscreen I've ever tried!!
avis.texte: It is rare that I leave a review since being experienced with so many products I have tried many tinted SPF that do not last and that feel so greasy. It takes a lot to wow me, I've tried IT cosmetics, Dr Jart, Mischa, Supergoop etc. this is the best

I have large pores and oily (summer) and combination (winter) skin, I have try so many skin tint spf product and this one felt the most comfortable. Blend well with one fingers and nice coverage when blend with the sponge that came in the compact. It also hold pretty well throughout the day, especially didn't budge around the nose area when i'm wearing glasses. The only biggest con is that the shade range are quite dissapointing.
medium coverage that does not irritate my rosacea. will be buying again

Ok, ok. I order the shade beige. For reference im a nc35, oily/acne prone. I was looking for something somewhat similar to SkinBetter compact spf. This does the job. It doesnt break me out, I also been wearing this on the go instead of a foundation its medium to full coverage. It doesnt have any smell imo. The beige shade is touch light and a touch on the pink side. But once i put bronzer and blush it evens out. This makes my skin look airbursh too every time i had wore this people compliment me on my skin which is nice! The only reason its not a 5⭐️ is the lack of shades.

avis.titre: Love the product, hate the shade range.
avis.texte: This is my holy grail foundation over pimple, its a natural finish with some medium coverage and the light shade my perfedr summer shade. But the shade range is abysmal. I feel bad using this knowing it wouldnt work for 90% of peole.
Full coverage, beautiful finish & hydrating. Just wish the shade range was better.

This product is amazing, so much so that I replaced my foundation with it. It matches my skin perfectly, which was a concern I had when ordering, as the beige looked too dark for my fair/light skin tone. It glides on the skin effortlessly with the provided sponge (will need to replace this probably weekly with daily use though) and covers like a full coverage foundation.

i am on my 4th compact and i will probably continue to buy this forever. not oily yet not drying, this product has never irritated my skin or clogged my pores. medium coverage that can be built up to full coverage. whenever my skin is having an acne flare up or dry patches THIS is what i reach for. i even use this as foundation when i go out. i love the natural finish.

wanted a high spf to reapply during Disney trips that easily fits in a small bag. this is perfect. the color dissipates into nothing. very little coverage. don't get this if you want actual foundation. but it's perfect for reapplying during the day without having to use fingers and spreading bacteria.

This compact sunscreen is incredible. I use this instead of regular foundation. It is smooth and creamy but dries down beautifully on my mature, pale, dry skin. The colors are forgiving. I use the Beige all over and Honey as a contour. Excellent products.

avis.titre: Please make a lighter shade with cool undertones!!
avis.texte: Beige is not light enough!! Please. Please. Please! Make a lighter shade for people with fair skin!
This performs like a high end foundation with the benefit of an effective SPF. Glides beautifully over my 44-year-old face. I'll be wearing this all summer long.

The product itself is great. Glides on, blends well, protects…. Where it lacks is shades. I am light-medium with warm to neutral under tones. I blend both shades to get the right shade but if you're lighter or darker these will not work. I used this as my reapplication throughout the day and it's easy to carry in my purse. Blends over any of my other sunscreens no problems.

I couldn't tell from the reviews if this was a pressed powder or a cream. If you're curious it is a cream compact. The color looks fine on my light/medium neutral undertone skin, but it is pretty shear. It also has a kinda greasy finish. I'm not sure how anyone would use this to touch up during the day if they were already wearing foundation. I think it would get heavy. But if you weren't wearing any foundation on your face it would probably be fine, but if you have oily or combo skin you'll probably need to powder too. I'm not sure how I feel about this product. I want to like it but I don't think I do.
Glides on smooth. You can build it up no problem. A little goes a long way. Blends beautifully.
Glides on smooth, you don't require much, you can build coverage. Feels good on the skin, doesn't cause breakouts.

avis.titre: Great feel and sunblocking but too dark
avis.texte: I love this product for the ease of application and rich creamy texture. It's perfect for repeat touchups over makeup or other sunscreen to keep your Spf lasting through the day…such as if you are going out to lunch and doing outdoor dining, and it's been 5 hours since you first applied your daily sunscreen… BUT the beige tint is so dark on my fair skin that I only use this where I might apply blush or bronzer and use a pointy makeup sponge to make sure it blends/feathers out into my lighter skin tone. Offers good concealing for age spots.

avis.titre: Better than regular sun screen for your face - Honey
avis.texte: Hard to describe, you'll have to try for yourself. Its a thick-ish but very spreadable cream. When you first smear it on with the sponge, you'll think it's so dark, but as you spread it out, it just becomes a tint of color. There is no coverage like foundation, its really just a sheer tint. On me it's looks like a tan filter. it's not sticky or runny, pretty much stays put. Anyone medium skin or darker could easily wear this Honey color I tried this a couple ways. 1)Adding powder on top didn't work, powder got stuck to it. 2) best combo was this + concealer under eyes, simple eye-shadow/mascara . Lasted through an 8 hr day cookout/pool party.
Honestly this can take place of your make up if you like the no make up look.. I'm going to continue using this. the fact that it has spf 50 is a plus!!

avis.titre: never will buy again, too many cons
avis.texte: I love Avene products and use many from the skin care line with great success. This, however, was a total failure for me. First the pros... it goes on easily and stays on. If you need a sunscreen to last a long time, this may be it. The compact is convenient for a purse or on a trip. It is non-irritating. I have very sensitive skin and had zero irritation with this. Now the cons... It clogs pores. I have not had clogged pores this bad in years, and this product did it. It settles into lines in a huge way and looks terrible. It is very thick. The compact form is not very sanitary over the long term and the pad that comes with this is not going to last more than a week or two. The color range, 2 colors only, is not good at all. The lightest color is a little too dark for me. So I bought it once, and I will never buy it again. Very disappointed.
I have lots of sun damage on my face and Dr recommended this product.
Nice product just wish that there was more coverage with this.
My very sensitive skin finally found a foundation with an SPF that doesn't cause a reaction. Yay! Thank you for keeping the ingredients clean enough for the most sensitive of skins.
Very nice consistency, non irritating for sensitive skin . However, it didn't do well with my dry skin ( it dried it out more ) . It might be good in summer when weather gets humid

avis.titre: Great product but awful shade range
avis.texte: This compact is wonderful, unfortunately, it is too dark! I can blend beige out to look nice on my face but compared with my neck or arm, it is too dark and yellow. Avene, please make this wonderful product in a fairer pink-toned color!!

avis.titre: Great product but too dark for fair skin tones
avis.texte: I have very fair, neutral toned skin and can use the Beige in the summer over my mineral sunscreen to color correct the blue-white tint, but it's too dark to use on it's own in the summer and WAY too dark in the fall/winter. PLEASE make a fair shade. I would love to wear this all doesn't look good on anyone - including people with pale skin. Bizarre that those of us who really need sun protection are ignored.

I had high hopes for this product but it was too light for my medium to dark brown skin. I gave it to a family member with a more fair skin tone and she loved it! More shades of this would be wonderful!
Working well on my skin , not just use of cream to powder type .
I love the light texture of this skin protector! It doesn't go on heavy or greasy but light and smooth.

I've been looking for a tinted sunscreen like this for years. I've tried countless brands and this one takes the cake. It's full coverage so I use it as a daily foundation. It's non greasy and leaves a matte finish. 10/10 recommend

avis.titre: Love this Product but to Dark
avis.texte: This is an absolutely amazing product, except for the lack of shades. It covers well, lasts all day, and the SPF protection is great. I ordered the powder in beige, thinking it might be light enough - wrong. Avene if your listening please offer this product in Light or Alabaster, we fair skin people would love to use it.

if you want something easy with light-medium coverage this is for you! i use my beauty blender and press it on, set it with some powder and i'm done. not to mention it includes spf 50 that doesn't sting my eyes. i'm surprised how much i've enjoyed using this product and i will repurchase again! the major con i would say is their color range is so limited and i probably can't use this once winter time rolls around. i hope this helps!
Love this product. I can use it in place of foundation all summer long! So easy to apply!
Amazing coverage, blends well , keeps you protected from the sun and makes you look pretty:)
This product goes on very nicely and stays in place. Also nice on reapplication. Would be wonderful to have more shades especially for darker complexions.

This formula is amazing. Beautiful, natural, dewy coverage but will not work for my skin tone beyond summer. Please invest in a Light Beige tone (and deeper tones for people of color). I layer this over Solaire for an extra layer of protection and my skin looks smooth and flawless, but in a natural way.
LOVE this!!!!! I am fighting sun damage and it is great for my dry skin and protection as well!!:heart:ï¸:heart:ï¸:heart:ï¸

I wish this product came in a lighter shade because I'm looking like an Oompa Loompa today! The product applies easily and doesn't burn my eyes but it's a little too shiny on my oily skin and the lightest shade is orange on me. It also settles in my fine lines and creases on my eyelids throughout the day. I love the idea of this product but I'm still on the hunt for a good facial mineral sunscreen.

This product is perfect if you like to have a makeup look without the heaviness of actual makeup and all the benefits of sunscreen. It feels comfortable and light on the skin, easy to apply and blends well.
This is the best sunscreen I've ever used!! Only thing, I wish there were lighter shades. Please please pleaseeeeeee make a lighter shade!

Love this product it covers my roscea /redness and pores. I'm fair skin but do tan so the beige was a perfect match. The quality is great if you put moisturizer on first. This product goes a long way.
I live the quality and Lightness of the compact. The liquid is more luminous. Both cover well.

The texture is a little thick, but it stays on well and provides good sun protection. I don't wear any makeup except for moisturizer, and this product doesn't feel like makeup. I have fair skin, and the beige color looks fine. The price reflects the quality.
This is the best I have ever have. I love how it covers my redness and protects my skin from the sun. I would be re-purchasing this from now on. Btw, I love how I dont even have to use make up.
Glides on! I was worried that the tint would be too dark when I saw the compact color but it was a lovely sheer tint. Went on smoothly and complemented my other minimalist make-up.
More color choices would be nice but love the product for quick touch ups!

I love this in beige. I have fair to light skin and it's the tiniest bit darker than my normal skin color but it looks fine. I apply it with a brush and then blend it out with a beauty blender and set it with powder and my skin looks absolutely flawless and it lasts all day long. It honestly looks airbrushed. I will only buy this as my fave makeup from now on. It is non comedogenic. Not all foundations are. Avene has given me the best skin I've even had in my entire life.
Has an elegant finish and no scent. Wish there were more shades, but the product is great.
This goes on beautifully and feels nice on the skin. I use it to hide the white cast from mineral sunscreen on my medium olive complexion. The beige is a good color match and it looks very natural.

I am pleasantly surprised with this product. It does not burn my skin like most SPF foundations do (chemical reaction). I do wish it weren't so thick. It's heavier than I prefer for coverage and look forward to washing it off at the end of the day. You don't get a lot of product for the price and it has VERY limited shades. I'm lucky that it mostly matches my skin tone, but it won't work for most people. Overall, I'm happy with the product.
I will repurchase this sunscreen . Leaves my face looking flawless. No greasy feeling like other sunscreen . Perfect match for me . I give credit to Dr.dray for my attention to this sunscreen.
Ease application and blending. I was pleasantly surprised how good it looks. Makes life easier with just one compact that includes the spf in it. I just love this product.
Love itttttt Totally Totally recommend it. I want to purchase more.
I LOVE this tinted compact. It covers the redness on my face but feels light. Easy to use and you don't need a lot for coverage. It even appears my skin looks better for using it.

I tried this on a whim and was not expecting to like it let alone love it. For me, it is a perfect match skin tone-wise and gives great coverage. I also use it to re-apply, when I need more sunscreen. Makes my skin look great.

i thought i loved the new mineral sunscreen, but this is better option for on the go!! i use it alone or on top of the sunscreen for more protection!! beige looks dark in the pan but once applied its so much lighter, will try honey for for summer!! great for dry skin! leaves you a nice glow throughout the day!
Easy to apply. Has the look of foundation with good coverage, along with the benefit of SPF 50. Very happy with product.
Bought the beige but it's too dark on my fair skin. Would like the option of lighter color with more pink undertones.
One of the best formulas I've tried but unfortunately beige is still a bit too dark for me. I hope the come out with a lighter shade soon because this is my favorite sunscreen!

68 years old, normal to dry skin. How this product has any five star review blows my mind. It leaves an ashy finish, never sets so leaves product gathered in places on the face. Clogs pores so looks like white dots all over.

I never write reviews but this compact deserves it. Im fair-medium skintone, so the beige was a good match, a little on the lighter side. It has spf which is a huge plus. But the thing that really sold me is how good it blends and how it does not bother my sensitive eczema-prone skin.
Love this product!! Great texture and coverage. Highly recommend
I absolutely love this product. It has enough tint that I don't need to wear makeup, is not greasy, and seems to stay all day. I also haven't broken out. The perfect solution for my melasma.

Love this brand and tinted touch to this sun screen that provides great coverage and exceptional sun protection. So light on the face and easy to apply. While physical sunscreen I don't have to worry about the white mask look.
Using AvenÃ© products my skin is so smooth I no longer need to use heavy foundation. My daily routine just got simple with great results.

Like the concept, like the consistency, don't like the yellow undertones. Ordered beige but does have yellow undertones and a tad dark for light complexions. Wish companies would make more pink undertone makeup. Nice product though.
Like the concept, the consistency is nice but need more color choices. The beige runs has yellow undertones. I wish companies would make more pink undertones.

I love this product so much. I use this as both my sunscreen and foundation in the summer months. I find that the coverage is medium and buildable. My skin tone is light neutral and the beige color is perfect. Perfect texture, great glow without being shiny, great product formulation, and easy to travel with. I couldn't ask for more than that!

I absolutely love this compact. It's amazing how it blends in so well with my skin tone. I have very sensitive skin and my face doesn't get irritated at all. It not only protects my skin from sun exposure but makes it look healthy at the same time. I can't imagine being without this!
I love the protection and the feel of it. The coverage is not really full coverage but just enough for me. I only wish they had more shades. Overall I would buy it again. I have bought it twice.

A little too dark and shiny for me (typically a light medium). A bit thick, too, but applies better with a brush than the included sponge if you want lighter coverage. Did not cause breakouts... Overall, this is just okay.

avis.titre: This creme tinted sunscreen has excellent coverage.
avis.texte: This has excellent coverage. Don't be afraid of the limited color choices. I'm very fair and I bought the lightest color and it was perfect. It blends well with your fingers or a makeup brush. It doesn't settle into poor like some foundations do. I would definitely buy again!

This is really a great product, it wears like makeup and provides good coverage. I like to layer it on top of my other non-tinted sunscreen moisturizer. I purchased it mainly because I heard good things about it protecting against visible light and hyperpigmentation

I wish this came in a wider shade range as it is a good product. More of a balmy texture, it doesn't bunch up in fine lines, and provides a nice finish that's more dewy. (I'm more dry/normal skin). Not long wearing, but easy to reapply or tap out. I got the lighter shade and am a medium complexion (~300 in fenty foundation) and don't see this working for anyone much lighter. The deeper shade doesn't seem much deeper either.
Love the tinted spf 50 compact for touch ups while out during the day . Because it's handy and affords an easy application , it's always in my handbag
This is a wonderful product. I have multiple allergies and have tried all kinds of SPF. This Compact is the first one that protects me from the sun and does not cause a rash.
I love it. Best purchase ever. Provides a perfect lightweight tint and looks like if you're wearing foundation.

This product was so greasy it sat on top of my skin and never fully set. I tried it over a couple of days and it just felt like an oil slick slowly sliding down my face. I don't recommend this product if you are the least bit oily.

I'm been trying to be better about wearing sunblock over the last couple of years. I really hate the feel and smell of most sunscreens. But this stuff is incredible! I've loved avène for years (ran out of moisturizer on a trip to Paris and discovered this brand in a pharmacy there), and I'm so excited that it's now more accessible in the US! This SPF compact leaves a beautiful sheen and provides a lot of coverage that is easy to blend out. I typically only spot conceal, so it took a little time to get used to wearing something all over my skin, but the cream to powder formulation feels like nothing! Only downside is I wish there were more shades to choose from. I'm really fair, like usually a porcelain shade, and I ordered the beige and it actually goes on a lot lighter than it looks in the compact and blends in well (and also makes me look a little tanner, which is nice in the sunnier months). I have combination skin, like oily and peeling at the same time, and this does highlight some of the spots that are flaky but I really love how weightless this is! I also have very acne prone, sensitive skin and this didn't cause any breakouts.

I bought this as a sunscreen, but I'm using it as a coverage/base product. I'm using it in the place of a tinted moisturizer or cc cream, and I think it will be great for summer. I'm 42 years old w/ dry, sensitive skin. I typically like base products w/ light coverage. I bought this thinking that it would work for mid-day sunscreen re-application. It could work that way, but I adore it as my base product. It leaves a beautiful sheen on my face that does not look greasy. I have light (between fair & medium) skin w/ neutral undertones. It looks waaayyy too dark in the compact, but blends beautifully. Even though I'm sure each shade suits a multitude of skin tones, a mere two shades will exclude lots & lots of people. Otherwise, it would have earned 5 stars.
Beautiful sunscreen but the reason I give it 4 stars is that it needs to have more shade choices! The shade beige is still too dark on my skin
I love the sheer natural color and the 50spf. I wish more colors were available such as a bronzer for a suntan look.
Itâ€™s a very good product and leaves your skin hydrated without feeling greasy.

I've been using this sunblock daily for a few years now. My only gripe is I wished it magically didn't rub off/color transfer with blowing my nose, or now on my mask. BUT, it makes my pale skin with cool undertones look dewy but not color-fake, evens out the redness in my cheeks, and truly provides sun protection. I feel pretty with it on, feel like my skin can still breathe, and for what it is I don't think the price is too high. I'd love to see it as a refill option so its more environmentally friendly. I had a check up with a new dermatologist this week, and she said my skin looks great for my age (43) with regard to sun damage, so thank you Avene!

I bought this for summer as an SPF and light weight option to my daily 2 minute face. Iâ€™m officially hooked. I like the way it goes on and how it provides just enough coverage to give you that natural look. It has a silky smooth feel and look.

This tinted sunscreen is so much more than just sun protection. It blends easy, goes on smooth and gives just enough coverage to even out my skin. Itâ€™s is lightweight enough to wear under foundation but itâ€™s great in its own.
Just the right compact with spf that I needed. Goes on smoothly, light feel and great tint.
I am trying to find a replacement for the tinted sunscreen which was THE BEST. This just wasn't the same at all. Very matte and heavy. I returned it. Please bring back the tinted sunscreen!!!
I love this Mineral Protection Compact for its high SPF. Used it during the summer sunny days. Really protects the face from the sunburn.
Great cover up, the only kind I can wear that doesnâ€™t irritate
